id: Star Wars: Episode I - The Phantom Menace (1999)

facts.text: Patience, Anakin. Eat your fill tonight, the trip to Coruscant is a long one.
facts.why: Qui-Gon never says this. His real lines include 'There's always a bigger fish' and 'Be mindful of the living Force, young Padawan.'

vibe.verdict: Watto's chalkboard and the Boonta Eve stub fit well, but the dishes lean generic and 'Tatooine blue milk' is not in this film.
missing: Jar Jar's 'Mesa your humble servant' in the Naboo swamp
Watto refusing Republic credits and the Jedi mind trick failing
Qui-Gon's 'There's always a bigger fish' (Otoh Gunga)
Qui-Gon wagering the hyperdrive part and Anakin on the podrace
Anakin accidentally blowing up the droid control ship
The Duel of the Fates in the Theed generator
ideas: Swap 'Tatooine blue milk' (first seen in Episode IV) for a Naboo pear cooler.
Replace the 'Mos Espa pear, nectarine and feta platter' note with Watto: 'No money! No parts! No deal!'
Swap the 'Theed palace fennel pork' note for Qui-Gon: 'Be mindful of the living Force.'
Add a Jar Jar swamp dish, 'Mesa stew', in place of 'Grilled corn with chilli butter'.
